shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- uikit version/docs ---\\n'; node -e \"console.log(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version)\"; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -path '*docs*INDEX.md' -o -name 'README.md' | head -10; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx; cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- README modal/button/setup ---'; rg -n -C 3 'Modal|Button|Required setup' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -120; printf '%s\\n' '--- Button dts ---'; rg -n 'interface ButtonProps|view:|size:|onClick' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/*.d.ts | head -100; printf '%s\\n' '--- Modal dts ---'; rg -n 'interface ModalProps|open|onClose|onEscape|visible|footer' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/*.d.ts | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*.d.ts' -print; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; printf '\\n--- Modal full ---\\n'; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts"
